name: Just a Pinch: the café counter
used: Just a Pinch (the Saltshaker Shrike): the whole background. The brass rail the Shrike hangs from, the plates, the diner, the salt and the Shrike are drawn on top.
standin: Striped wallpaper, a chalk menu board, a clock, the kitchen hatch and a long counter, painted in code.
prompt: {STYLE} {SCENE}Inside a small old-fashioned café, seen straight on. A long counter runs across the whole width: its pale marble top is a straight horizontal band from 70% to 74% down (plates slide along it from right to left), and below it the counter's front is panelled wood painted dusty pink, down to the bottom edge. Above the counter, the back wall is papered in soft cream and sage-green stripes. Top left, a small chalk menu board with a few illegible scribbled lines (no readable words); top right, a plain round wall clock; at the far right edge, above the counter, the dark open hatch of the kitchen with a little steam, where the plates come out. Leave a clear stretch of counter and wall at the far left for a diner, and keep the wide band of wallpaper in the middle, from 10% to 68% down and from 20% to 85% across, plain and uncluttered, because salt falls through it. No people, animals, plates or food, and no rail along the top (the game draws its own).

name: Plates of food
used: Just a Pinch: the plates that slide along the counter; the first six want salt, the last two are puddings that want none.
standin: A white plate and simple foods drawn in code.
prompt: {STYLE} {SHEET} A 4 x 2 grid of eight dishes, each served on the same plain white china plate seen from the side and slightly above, the plate about 420 px wide with its foot on the bottom of the picture, row by row: 1, a fried egg with a bright yolk; 2, a heap of golden chips; 3, a baked potato split open with a pat of butter; 4, a buttery cob of sweetcorn; 5, a white bowl of tomato soup on the plate; 6, a big brown pretzel; 7, a slice of strawberry layer cake with a cherry on top; 8, an ice-cream sundae in a tall glass, strawberry and vanilla with chocolate sauce. The food sits in the middle of each plate, no cutlery.

name: Diners
used: Just a Pinch: the diner at the end of the counter who tastes each plate; pleased (and bouncing) when it's right, pulling a face when it isn't.
standin: Round grey, brown and green creatures with a napkin and a fork, drawn in code.
prompt: {STYLE} {SHEET} A 4 x 2 grid of four small animal diners in Lobel's gentle manner, each seen from the front, from the waist up as if sitting behind a counter (the bottom of each figure cut straight across), about 380 px tall, with a white napkin tucked under its chin and a fork held upright: row 1, waiting happily: a velvety dark-grey mole with tiny round spectacles, a grey mouse, a green frog, a black-and-white badger; row 2, the same four in the same order pulling a face at their food: eyes screwed shut, mouth turned down, tongue out.

name: Saltshaker Shrike hanging upside down
used: Just a Pinch: the Shrike hangs head down from the brass rail all game (pose 1), shakes out a pinch (pose 2), squawks pleased at a plate that's just right (pose 3) and flinches at a frown (pose 4). The game mirrors it to face the plates.
standin: The portrait (or its stand-in) turned upside down in code; it jiggles when shaking, bounces when pleased and shivers when flinching.
prompt: {STYLE} {VARIANT} The Saltshaker Shrike (https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hoai2k/mini/main/icecreamcone/game/assets/subjects/saltshakershrike.png) in four poses side by side, each in its own square quarter of the sheet, all at the same scale, facing left, each hanging UPSIDE DOWN by its claws from an unseen horizontal rail at the very top of the square, like a bat: its thin legs go straight up from the body to the claws, which grip a point at the top centre of the square; the glass body hangs below them and the domed perforated silver cap (its head) points straight down, the cap's holes about 75% of the way down the square, centred, the hooked beak and black eye mask on the cap. Lit from the upper left as a real object hanging upside down would be. 1, hanging still, calm; 2, shaking: swung slightly to one side, a little puff of white salt grains spilling from the holes; 3, pleased: beak wide open in a cheerful squawk, little wings flared; 4, flinching: body pulled up tight towards the rail, wings clamped, eye squeezed half shut. No rail drawn. {ALPHA}
